{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, check for any non-numeric entries that might cause issues
invalid_revenue = data[~data['revenue'].str.match(r'^\d+,?\d*\.?\d*$')]['revenue'].unique()
print("Invalid revenue entries (not matching pattern):", invalid_revenue)

# Clean: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify conversion
print("Sample cleaned revenue:", data['revenue_clean'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = (data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print("QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", qa_orders)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
print("Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers:", mean_revenue)"}
